reviewer: independent grading agent, separate from service and adapter/provider builders

findings.finding: An identical request could commit between receipt lookup and a preparation/owned snapshot. The losing caller then treated the committed target as stale and returned a conflict instead of the authoritative receipt.
findings.resolution: Preparation, post-model compatibility checks and every owned CAS preparation reconcile guard failures against the exact scoped semantic receipt. Missing receipts retain the original guard error; conflicting intents retain IdempotencyConflict and unreadable authority yields ReceiptCommitUncertain.

findings.finding: Preserved meta.summary could override corrected text through MemoryItem.cached_summary and put the obsolete claim back into normal retrieved context.
findings.resolution: Recognized content-update decision metadata invalidates cached summaries at read time. Current text is used without modifying stored metadata or earlier receipts; legacy summaries retain their existing behavior.

reviewed_properties: Canonical finite request freezing and exact full-record digest protect text, target, scope and typed provenance.
Only text, embedding and latest content-update decision mutate; creation time, trust, lifecycle, expiry, capacity, other records and historical receipts remain intact.
Identity descriptors and prepared vectors are detached; same-object descriptor mutation, retained vector aliasing, invalid values, dimension drift and CAS races fail closed.
Historical receipt replay precedes current target/model checks and intentionally does not reinterpret an old receipt using the current embedding contract.
Terminal aliases and decisions, missing exact scope members, unknown prior decision formats and malformed UTF-8 prior reasons cannot be silently overwritten.
Embedding executes outside store ownership; unrelated writes rebase, changed target/space fails, and competing same-key requests converge to one receipt.
Durable success survives observer/hydration failure and lost acknowledgements; failed or interrupted writes do not invent a receipt or reverse a commit.
Provider validation and typed failure responses remain narrow; projections/outbox/context carry corrected content and preserved provenance.
Journal/receipt/outbox schemas remain unchanged; production inventory remains candidate with no stable-platform claim.

plan_position: Eleventh serial hardening gate after foundations; P03 durable lifecycle receipts, P04 schema compatibility and P07 content semantics; original ten production areas remain incomplete
limitations: Declared embedding identity is a point-in-time operator/backend assertion, not weight attestation or semantic model-quality proof.
Raw provenance markers and receipts are not authentication against an attacker able to rewrite all authoritative history.
Backend latency is not bounded by store ownership timeout; backend deadlines remain a caller/provider responsibility.
Process-death and SQLite quota tests do not qualify physical power-loss behavior or every storage device.
Retained history and full-state verification/events continue to have growth costs; prior receipts and already-built context retain historical content.
Full repository and exact-commit CI acceptance remain the root release gate; this reviewer did not execute remote CI.
Candidate feature-specific acceptance; stable API inventory remains empty and production_ready remains false
Exact authoritative record required for digest; no new inspection endpoint or per-token scope authorization
No promotion/merge, retention/physical erasure, automatic re-embedding or implicit embedding contract adoption
Real-agent 1k/10k/100k campaigns, native KV compatibility completion and full operator replay remain open
